issues.title: Pinned workspace does not match available dependencies
issues.impact: The documented build refuses to run and another migration can use incompatible framework artifacts.
issues.current_workaround: None; do not bypass the doctor for a release build.
issues.recommended_solution: Restore pinned revisions or deliberately update revisions, hashes, synced artifacts, and compatibility tests in one reviewed change.

issues.title: Newer runtime/SSG direct build produced partial output
issues.impact: A version-skewed build may leave incomplete output.
issues.current_workaround: Use only a verified pinned toolchain after lock repair.
issues.recommended_solution: Reproduce with the locked revisions, capture exit/error, then add a cross-version compatibility or explicit incompatibility contract.

issues.title: Taxonomy archives are materialized content rather than generated from post metadata
issues.impact: Derived archive content can drift and each migration must recreate taxonomy logic.
issues.current_workaround: Generate Markdown archive items during import.
issues.recommended_solution: Add first-class taxonomy terms, normalization, collisions, pagination, metadata, overrides, and migration fixtures.

issues.title: Watch mode is explicitly not implemented
issues.impact: Normal editing requires manual rebuild/server coordination.
issues.current_workaround: Run an explicit build and separate static server.
issues.recommended_solution: Implement tested debounce/watch behavior or publish a supported interim loop and remove misleading feature expectations.

issues.title: No reusable migration route, redirect, collision, or waiver tool exists
issues.impact: Each site duplicates inventory and validation policy.
issues.current_workaround: Hard-coded importer lists and site-specific required routes.
issues.recommended_solution: Build a migration CLI that emits route inventory/diff, redirects, collisions, exceptions, and receipts.
issues.target_repository: Kujo SSG or Kujo migration tooling

issues.title: Consumer artifact layout required local font-path transformation
issues.impact: Consumers can ship broken fonts or copy undocumented transforms.
issues.recommended_solution: Release a consumer bundle or adapter with stable asset paths and a consumer smoke test.

issues.title: SiteKit has no stable consumer version/release contract in the demonstrated integration
issues.impact: Multi-site upgrades are source-copy operations with implicit compatibility.
issues.current_workaround: Vendored artifacts pinned by a website-owned manifest.
issues.recommended_solution: Choose a documented versioned distribution model with compatibility metadata and upgrade report.

issues.title: Latest recorded visual/accessibility receipt failed home-page checks
issues.impact: Current accessibility claims are not release-proven after theme changes.
issues.recommended_solution: Re-run the receipt after current changes; fix contrast and image-link names or record approved evidence-backed exceptions.

issues.title: Historic broken-link warnings are not baseline-waived
issues.impact: New broken links can be hidden among intentional historic debt.
issues.current_workaround: Warnings pass and only the first 20 print.
issues.recommended_solution: Persist a complete reviewed JSON waiver baseline and fail any new/unapproved internal link.

issues.title: Importer input snapshot and execution receipt were not retained
evidence: absence of legacy snapshot/run receipt in repository
issues.impact: The migration is auditable but cannot be replayed exactly.
issues.current_workaround: Read committed converted content and CSV as indirect evidence.
issues.recommended_solution: Preserve a source inventory/checksum and machine-readable importer receipt without committing unnecessary raw exports.

issues.title: Taxonomy classification uses content keyword heuristics
issues.impact: Terms can be misclassified or inconsistently normalized on another source site.
issues.current_workaround: Fixed keyword branches and a default Engineering Archive category.
issues.recommended_solution: Extract source taxonomy when available; otherwise generate a reviewable classification manifest and require approval.

issues.title: No current SSG+SiteKit consumer compatibility matrix/example is available
issues.impact: Agents must infer compatible revisions and asset conventions.
issues.current_workaround: This repository owns its own manifest and sync implementation.
issues.recommended_solution: Publish one tested consumer fixture with revisions, asset contract, build, and upgrade instructions.

issues.title: Importer retains unreachable richer-normalization code after an early return
issues.impact: Future maintainers may assume headings/tables/TOC normalization is active.
issues.current_workaround: Plain Markdown conversion path returns first.
issues.recommended_solution: Delete the dead block or feature-flag/test it when trusted raw HTML has a defined contract.

issues.title: Responsive image processing and build determinism were not demonstrated
evidence: no retained determinism or image-pipeline receipt
issues.impact: Future migrations may add ad hoc image scripts or stale output behavior.
issues.current_workaround: Manual hero variants and direct asset copy.
issues.recommended_solution: Define/test image derivatives, asset URL policy, deletion cleanup, and byte/hash determinism.
